rows.text: In between the red rocks in Insumousu, you discover the white stone sculpture of a human head. Its size is just right to be held in your fist. You read the inscription on the stone platform that says, "{RUBY_B#Aeon of Abundance} Yaoshi{RUBY_E#}."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: On the spur of the moment, you wrap your fingers around the sculpture, feeling it transforming into a bird in your hand. Its longevity proliferates and expands in a visualized form. Then, scarlet liquid flows through your fingers.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "...All sentient beings... will have all their wishes fulfilled... torment and healing... are in a symbiotic relationship..."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
